original_question: Let X be a metrizable space. If, for every metric d compatible with the topology of X, the Wijsman hyperspace (2^X, T_W(d)) is a Baire space, must the Vietoris hyperspace (2^X, T_V) also be a Baire space?
target_in_paper: Section 4, Question 4.8: the paper asks whether, for a metrizable space X, if the Wijsman hyperspace (2^X, T_W(d)) is Baire for every metric d compatible with the topology of X, then the Vietoris hyperspace (2^X, τ_V) must be Baire. ([openrepository.aut.ac.nz](https://openrepository.aut.ac.nz/bitstreams/be63513c-6554-4988-96ce-96c8dd6f7050/download))
correct_elements: Your draft already captures the exact scope of the paper's Question 4.8 almost verbatim: X is a metrizable space, the hypothesis ranges over every compatible metric d on X, and the conclusion asks about Baireness of the Vietoris hyperspace on the same carrier 2^X. ([openrepository.aut.ac.nz](https://openrepository.aut.ac.nz/bitstreams/be63513c-6554-4988-96ce-96c8dd6f7050/download))
missing_details: Define 2^X explicitly as the family of all nonempty closed subsets of X.
State explicitly that a metric d is compatible with X if it generates the given topology of the metrizable space X.
Use the paper's hyperspace notation consistently: the conclusion is about the Vietoris topology τ_V on 2^X.
Make the question fully stand-alone by naming both hyperspace topologies on the same underlying set 2^X, rather than assuming the reader already knows the paper's notation.
refined_question: Let X be a metrizable space, and let 2^X denote the set of all nonempty closed subsets of X. Suppose that for every metric d compatible with the topology of X, the Wijsman hyperspace (2^X, T_W(d)) is a Baire space. Must the Vietoris hyperspace (2^X, τ_V) also be a Baire space?
equivalent_formulation: Equivalently, after choosing any compatible metric d0 on X and using the paper's identity τ_V = sup{T_W(ρ) : ρ is a metric on X equivalent to d0}, does Baireness of every Wijsman topology in this family force the supremum hyperspace topology τ_V to be Baire? ([openrepository.aut.ac.nz](https://openrepository.aut.ac.nz/bitstreams/be63513c-6554-4988-96ce-96c8dd6f7050/download))
justification: The draft is aiming at the narrower open problem in Section 4, not the broader Problem 4.1. The nearby context is exactly the one the paper uses to motivate Question 4.8: Problem 4.1 asks for characterizations of when a Wijsman hyperspace is Baire; Theorem 4.3 shows that X^ℵ0 being Baire implies (2^X, T_W(d)) is Baire for every compatible metric d; immediately after that, the paper recalls examples separating fixed-metric Wijsman Baireness from Vietoris Baireness and then states Question 4.8 in the form your draft is targeting. The author also notes that no partial information was known there toward Questions 4.8 and 4.9. ([openrepository.aut.ac.nz](https://openrepository.aut.ac.nz/bitstreams/be63513c-6554-4988-96ce-96c8dd6f7050/download))
